name: base_s1x
setup: set -e; pip install -q numpy tokenizers matplotlib transformers==4.51.3; T=/opt/babylm/ruler_tools_c09ef37ac16bbe0a9f3ab9def66ad000ea40cef5; mkdir -p $T; gsutil -q cp "$RULER_TOOLS_URI" /tmp/rt.tgz; tar -xzf /tmp/rt.tgz -C $T; python -m babylm.data.prepare --download; $T/babylm/eval/setup.sh /opt/babylm

jobs.name: base_s1x
jobs.cmd: SKIP=; for n in base_S_wd1p0_lr0p25 base_S_wd2p0_lr0p25 base_S_wd1p0_lr0p125 base_S_wd2p0_lr0p125; do if [ -n "$SKIP" ] && echo $n | grep -qE "$SKIP"; then echo "[reg] skip $n"; continue; fi; python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_base_grid_S.json --only $n --device cuda || echo "[run] train $n failed"; [ -f babylm/runs/$n/result.json ] && { bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/$n /opt/babylm || echo "[run] score $n failed"; }; done
